post.text:
The Coalition Government is eroding the principles of transparency & accountability that all New Zealanders deserve from any government.

A Green Government will put people and planet before profit & revoke consents that sidestep long held protections to exploit our environment under the fast-track.

source.agency_name: Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
